subject: Use server.current_client to decide whether cluster commands should return TLS info. (#12569)
reason: The change only alters which port cluster commands report — the TLS port vs. the plaintext port — and only for fake clients (Lua EVAL, module RM_call) whose connection is NULL; for real client connections server.current_client is that same client, so shouldReturnTlsInfo() returns exactly what the old connIsTLS(c->conn) returned. The TLS and TCP ports are only distinct on a node that actually has a TLS listener, which requires a BUILD_TLS build started with tls-port and valid certificates (or tls-cluster yes).
